name: io.github.kodenova/sap-b1-mcp
title: SAP Business One (read-only)
description: Read-only SAP Business One Service Layer tools: partners, items, orders, invoices, stock.

environmentVariables.name: SAPB1_SERVICE_LAYER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Service Layer base URL, e.g. https://your-b1-server:50000/b1s/v1

environmentVariables.name: SAPB1_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Dedicated B1 user with read-only authorizations

environmentVariables.name: SAPB1_ALLOW_SELF_SIGNED
environmentVariables.description: Set to true only if your Service Layer uses a self-signed certificate

environmentVariables.name: SAPB1_MAX_ROWS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum rows any tool may return (default 50, hard cap 500)

environmentVariables.name: SAPB1_SAVED_QUERIES_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the saved-queries JSON file used by run_saved_query

environmentVariables.name: SAPB1_MOCK
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to use bundled demo fixtures instead of SAP
